# Build tenboards UI

Default to the existing compact system and read-only demo data unless the user asks
for live data. Use the generator, then adapt its domain; do not offer a new design system.
Read root AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md. Inspect `/dashboard/kit` and the local component
before composing. If Impeccable is installed, use Operate mode and its craft floor.

## External projects

Inside a tenboards clone, keep using `@/components/blocks`. Only when installing
blocks into another initialized React 19 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn project, use the
kit's registry links and current-host `npx shadcn add` commands. Items install
under `components/tenboards`, include chart helpers and apply the default global
theme/compact CSS. Review that CSS change; retain accessible chart data alternatives.
`/llms.txt` indexes the registry and guidance; resolve its root-relative URLs
against the host from which you fetched it before passing a URL to shadcn.

## Progress checklist

- [ ] Run `npm run new:dashboard <slug>` for metrics/charts or `npm run new:page <slug>`
  for a listing. Both live at `/dashboard/<slug>`; optional `-- --title "Title"` sets the title.
  Generators register sidebar, route catalog and parity reads and reject occupied slugs.
- [ ] Read [block contracts](references/blocks.md) for the blocks you need. Adapt
  generated `-components/`, server types and canonical fixtures together; use realistic
  neutral sample records. Update table headings, accessible labels, empty copy and KPI
  units to match the requested domain. Do not leave generic requests in a Vendors page.
- [ ] Preserve the generated guarded loader and `readSource` boundary. Components
  import types only from the server layer, never fixtures. For a real DB query, use
  `tenboards-connect-data`; clearly retain the illustrative DB TODO until implemented.
- [ ] Run `npm run build`, `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`.
- [ ] Run `npm run check:design` and `npm run verify:page -- /dashboard/<slug>`.
  Use an isolated demo server/port for scratch work, e.g. `--base-url http://127.0.0.1:3404`.
  Read `verify/report.json` and route reports; fix violations/runtime errors and rerun.
- [ ] Inspect the four light/dark × desktop/mobile captures, empty state, keyboard
  controls and reduced motion. Report actual results and any remaining blocker.

## Gotchas

- SSR clocks must share an initial value; live clocks start after hydration. Delayed
  hydration evidence must actually delay scripts, not expire during server startup
  ([review #24](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/24#discussion_r4359849605)).
- A tooltip `formatter` replaces the whole row: preserve series labels as well as
  values ([review #24](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/24#discussion_r4359849593)).
- Compact desktop sizing must not shrink mobile grouped inputs into focus zoom
  ([review #65](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/65#discussion_r4368113744)).
  Keep body/table ≥13px, metadata ≥12px and targets ≥24px per DESIGN.md.
- A login redirect is not a verified dashboard. Check the final route and use the
  intended demo server ([review #78](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/78#discussion_r4375549966)).
- Tokens, not literals or arbitrary typography escapes; new pages get no exception
  ([review #78](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/78#discussion_r4375549973)).
- Framework/API invariants (not invented review findings): route groups add no URL
  segment; never hand-edit `routeTree.gen.ts`; spread `useChartMotion()` on animated
  series/tooltips so SSR and reduced motion stay stable. Use the local Table v9 API,
  not v8 `useReactTable` examples.

### Scratch evaluation corrections (v0.9 / 004)

- The Sales eval initially assumed a third options argument to `formatCurrency`
  and a Table `sortFn: "basic"`. The agent corrected both: the helper accepts only
  `(value, currency?)`; numeric columns use a numeric comparator. Wrap it for chart
  tick callbacks so an index is not passed as the currency argument. Read installed
  signatures before borrowing examples.
- Scratch evaluations with a symlinked `node_modules` hit Nitro dev-runner module
  resolution errors and HTTP 503 before page rendering. Install dependencies inside
  each scratch clone; alternatively build and run `npm run preview -- --port <port>`
  and pass that origin to `verify:page`. This is a harness setup failure, not an
  accessibility pass; preserve the failed report alongside the successful rerun.
- Gitignored scratch TSX probes can still enter `tsc` through tsconfig's include
  patterns. The Sales empty-state probe introduced an unused React import; remove
  temporary probes after verification and rerun typecheck. Gitignore is not a
  TypeScript exclusion.

## Controls and filter rows

Use one size step, align end (`items-end`), and use NativeSelect/Select, never raw `<select>`. Date fields use Input. Label/field stacks use flex-column gaps, not space-y around Select's hidden input. Default controls are 28px desktop / 32px mobile. Secondary toolbar actions use ghost; keep one primary action. Use FilterSelect for clearable filters and its searchable mode for long lists; counts are optional option metadata. See the kit regression row and measure control heights/bottom edges before shipping.


## Source: .agents/skills/tenboards-build-ui/references/blocks.md

# Public block contracts

Import from `@/components/blocks`; inspect the TSDoc/source for the exact installed API.
Chart primitives also export from `@/components/blocks/charts`, never import `recharts`
directly in routes. The executable kit is `src/routes/(main)/dashboard/kit/-components/`.

| Block | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| PageHeader | `title: string`, optional `description: string`, `actions`, `className`; one h1 per page |
| DashboardCard | Native Card props plus `density: "compact" | "standard"`; default standard already follows compact responsive tokens |
| SectionHeader | `title`, optional `description`, `actions`, `level: 2 | 3`, `id`; compose inside DashboardCard |
| StatCard | `label: string`, `value: ReactNode`; optional `help`, `trend`, `actions`, `icon`, `density`, `level`, `className` |
| CardContent | Public re-export of the existing card content slot |
| DataTable | Caller-owned `table`, required accessible `label`; optional `empty`, `pagination`, `mobile: "reflow" | "scroll"`, `columnLabels`, `className` |
| DashboardChart | ChartContainer props, including `config` and `children`; default responsive height |
| DashboardTooltip | ChartTooltipContent props; custom formatter replaces the entire row |
| DashboardLegend | Required named-series `config`, optional payload and className |

For tables copy the generator's `./scripts/templates/records-table.tsx.template`:
`ColumnDef<DataTableFeatures, Row>[]`, `useTable({ features: dataTableFeatures, data,
columns, getRowId, initialState })`. Headers are plain labels: DataTable supplies
sorting buttons. `mobile="reflow"` is the default. Use an informative empty state.

Charts use `seriesConfig({ revenue: "Revenue" })`, `chartAxis`, `chartGrid`,
`chartCursor` and `useChartMotion()`. Spread motion onto each mark and Tooltip;
use `config.revenue.color` for marks and preserve labels in custom tooltips.
Copy the generated activity chart's accessible table alternative when changing series.
Use `formatCurrency(value, currency?)`, `formatNumber(value)` and `formatPercent(value)`
for explicit en-US formatting. For chart ticks use `(value) => formatCurrency(value)`;
a chart callback may pass an index as its second argument. Numeric Table columns
use `(a, b, id) => a.getValue<number>(id) - b.getValue<number>(id)`, not a v8 sort name.

Use named layout classes such as `min-w-0 space-y-5`, `grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3`.
Do not copy raw primitive Card/Table markup to imitate blocks or add raw colors,
arbitrary sizing, new density overrides or exceptions to pass a new page.


## Source: .agents/skills/tenboards-connect-data/SKILL.md

---
name: tenboards-connect-data
description: Connect tenboards typed reads to demo fixtures and Postgres with Drizzle. Use when adding a data source, database query, schema migration, seed, parity scenario, or auth-guarded server loader.
license: MIT
metadata:
  version: "1.0"
---
# Connect tenboards data

Preserve the zero-config demo and one typed contract across demo and database reads.
Read [data workflow](references/data-workflow.md) before changing schema, seeds or
server functions. Keep presentation in blocks and route-local components.

## Progress checklist

- [ ] Inspect the owning domain read and generated types/fixture. Define validated
  inputs and one serializable output contract; choose stable IDs and deterministic order.
- [ ] Implement separate demo and DB functions behind `readSource`. Keep fixtures
  server-side. Replace generated DB TODOs with real ordered queries before claiming
  database integration; comparing two fixture clones does not prove DB parity.
- [ ] Add an additive migration and repeatable fixture seed if persistence is needed.
  Never rewrite shipped migration SQL/journal history or overwrite adopter records.
- [ ] Keep `requireSession()` inside each app-data server function before reading data,
  even when its parent route is guarded. Validate inputs at the server boundary.
- [ ] Register all reads/scenarios and run migrations, seed and `npm run data:parity`
  against an explicitly selected disposable local database. Check missing/filter/empty
  cases, deterministic ordering, repeat seeds and date boundaries where relevant.
- [ ] Run build/check/typecheck; verify any affected page with `verify:page` and
  report demo and DB evidence separately. No database access means DB acceptance
  remains unverified; finish independent demo work and report the missing prerequisite.

## Gotchas

- Apply SQL filters before result limits; filtering the first 100 rows in memory
  loses matching records ([review #67](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/67#discussion_r4368227630)).
- Verify the requested page, not a login redirect ([review #78](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/pull/78#discussion_r4375549966)).
- Existing source/auth contracts: configured DB errors remain visible, never fall
  back to fixtures; demo identities are not authenticated users or ownership checks.
  No CRUD, RBAC or authentication changes are implied by adding a typed read.


## Source: .agents/skills/tenboards-connect-data/references/data-workflow.md

# Typed reads, schema and parity

Read `docs/data-layer.md` and the nearest domain before editing. Small example:
`src/server/data/users.ts`; complex filtering/date examples: `projects.ts`.

1. Put serializable types in `src/server/data/<domain>.types.ts`; validate inputs with
   the installed Zod. Preserve numbers, nulls, ordering and date semantics across sources.
2. Canonical fixtures belong in `src/server/db/fixtures/`. Demo functions return fresh
   data (`structuredClone` for static fixtures), so caller mutation cannot leak across requests.
3. DB functions dynamically import `getDatabase` from `client.server.ts` and schema;
   use normalized entity tables and ordered queries. Workers clients are request-scoped.
   Apply validated filters before limits, then project exactly the same output shape.
4. Export `read<Domain>` using `readSource(() => demo(input), () => db(input))`.
   No DATABASE_URL means demo; DATA_SOURCE=demo explicitly forces demo. Configured
   unreachable/unmigrated databases produce a sanitized visible error, not demo fallback.
5. Follow `./scripts/templates/load.ts.template`: `createServerFn({ method: "GET" })`,
   dynamic server imports, `await requireSession()` before the read. Route loaders
   call this function; components receive loader data and type-only imports.
6. Extend `src/server/db/schema.ts` and generate an additive migration with
   `npm run db:generate`. Inspect SQL before applying it. Keep shipped migrations intact.
   Seed from canonical fixtures with stable keys; preserve unrelated and adopter rows.
7. Register distinct demo/DB implementations in `src/server/data/registry.ts` with
   all/existing/missing/filter/empty scenarios as applicable. Date-relative records use
   one serialized request reference; test later requests without reseeding.

For a disposable local Postgres database, explicitly set its DATABASE_URL outside
committed files, then run `npm run db:migrate`, `npm run db:seed`, and
`npm run data:parity`. The parity runner checks every exported read is registered,
compares actual outputs and verifies caller mutation isolation. Repeated seed and
populated upgrades must retain unrelated records. Do not run remote migrations/seeds
without explicit authorization; never print credentials in evidence.

The generator intentionally emits an illustrative DB stub. It is useful for a demo
page, but is not evidence of a schema, query or seed. For demo-only work keep its TODO
and describe that limitation rather than inventing persistence.


## Source: src/components/blocks/cards.tsx

```tsx
import { type ComponentProps, type ReactNode, useId } from "react";

import { cn } from "cn";

import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/card";

/** Card surface using the shared compact or standard spacing; compose with UI card slots. */
export type DashboardCardProps = ComponentProps<typeof Card> & {
  /** Compact uses 12px spacing; standard follows responsive card tokens. Defaults to standard. */
  density?: "compact" | "standard";
};

/** Shared dashboard card. All native Card props, children and accessible names pass through. */
export function DashboardCard({ density = "standard", className, ...props }: DashboardCardProps) {
  return <Card {...props} size={density === "compact" ? "sm" : "default"} className={cn("min-w-0", className)} />;
}

/** Props for a card-level semantic heading. */
export interface SectionHeaderProps {
  /** Visible section heading. */
  title: ReactNode;
  /** Supporting content below the heading. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Route-owned controls, wrapping beside the heading. */
  actions?: ReactNode;
  /** Heading hierarchy; defaults to h2. */
  level?: 2 | 3;
  /** Heading ID for aria-labelledby and fragment links. */
  id?: string;
}

/** Wrapping h2/h3 header for DashboardCard, with optional description and actions. */
export function SectionHeader({ title, description, actions, level = 2, id }: SectionHeaderProps) {
  const Heading = level === 2 ? "h2" : "h3";
  return (
    <CardHeader className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-40">
        <Heading id={id} className="text-base font-medium tracking-tight wrap-break-word">
          {title}
        </Heading>
        {description && <div className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-sm">{description}</div>}
      </div>
      {actions && <div className="flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{actions}</div>}
    </CardHeader>
  );
}

/** Props for an accessibly labelled metric card. */
export interface StatCardProps {
  /** Heading hierarchy; defaults to h2. */
  level?: 2 | 3;
  /** Accessible metric name and visible heading. */
  label: string;
  /** Route-formatted metric; units and locale belong to the caller. */
  value: ReactNode;
  /** Supporting explanation below the value. */
  help?: ReactNode;
  /** Text or indicator alongside the value; pair color with a label. */
  trend?: ReactNode;
  /** Route-owned controls in the card header. */
  actions?: ReactNode;
  /** Optional decorative or accessibly named icon. */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** Card spacing; defaults to standard. */
  density?: "compact" | "standard";
  /** Additional layout classes. */
  className?: string;
}

/** Metric card with tabular values and optional help, trend, icon and action slots. */
export function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  help,
  trend,
  actions,
  icon,
  density = "standard",
  level = 2,
  className,
}: StatCardProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const Heading = level === 2 ? "h2" : "h3";
  return (
    <DashboardCard density={density} className={className} role="group" aria-labelledby={id}>
      <CardHeader>
        {icon}
        <Heading id={id} className="text-muted-foreground text-sm font-medium wrap-break-word">
          {label}
        </Heading>
        {actions && <CardAction>{actions}</CardAction>}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="min-w-0 text-2xl leading-tight font-medium tracking-tight wrap-break-word tabular-nums xl:text-3xl">
            {value}
          </div>
          {trend}
        </div>
        {help && <div className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{help}</div>}
      </CardContent>
    </DashboardCard>
  );
}

```

## Source: src/components/blocks/charts.tsx

```tsx
import { type ComponentProps, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

import { cn } from "cn";

import { ChartContainer, type ChartLegendContent, ChartTooltipContent } from "@/components/ui/chart";

/** Opaque chart colors and distinct line patterns. chart-3 is danger red, kept off the default four-series set. */
export const chartSeries = [
  { color: "var(--chart-1)", strokeDasharray: undefined },
  { color: "var(--chart-2)", strokeDasharray: "6 3" },
  { color: "var(--chart-4)", strokeDasharray: "2 3" },
  { color: "var(--chart-5)", strokeDasharray: "8 3 2 3" },
] as const;

/** Accessible series identity shared by marks, tooltip and legend. */
export interface SeriesStyle {
  /** Human-readable series name. */
  label: string;
  /** CSS token color for marks and legend samples. */
  color: string;
  /** Supplementary line pattern so color is not the only distinction. */
  strokeDasharray?: string;
}

/** Assign shared colors/patterns to named series in insertion order; styles repeat after four series. */
export function seriesConfig<T extends string>(labels: Record<T, string>): Record<T, SeriesStyle> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries<string>(labels).map(([key, label], index) => [
      key,
      { label, ...chartSeries[index % chartSeries.length] },
    ]),
  ) as Record<T, SeriesStyle>;
}

/** Recharts axis props: muted 12px ticks without decorative axis lines. */
export const chartAxis = {
  axisLine: false,
  tickLine: false,
  tickMargin: 8,
  tick: { fill: "var(--text-muted)", fontSize: 12 },
} as const;
/** Recharts CartesianGrid props for decorative dashed horizontal separators. */
export const chartGrid = { vertical: false, stroke: "var(--border)", strokeDasharray: "3 3" } as const;
/** Recharts tooltip cursor props using a dashed muted stroke. */
export const chartCursor = { stroke: "var(--text-muted)", strokeDasharray: "3 3" } as const;

/** Format a number using the explicit en-US locale. */
export const formatNumber = (value: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US").format(value);
/** Format an amount using en-US and the supplied ISO currency (USD by default). */
export const formatCurrency = (value: number, currency = "USD") =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
/** Format a ratio as an en-US percentage with at most one decimal place. */
export const formatPercent = (value: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "percent", maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(value);

function subscribeMotion(onChange: () => void) {
  const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}
// Static SSR and first client paint; enable short animations only after hydration.
/** SSR-safe reduced-motion subscription. Spread onto every animated series and tooltip. */
export function useChartMotion() {
  const reduced = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeMotion,
    () => window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches,
    () => true,
  );
  return { isAnimationActive: !reduced, animationDuration: 200 } as const;
}

/** ChartContainer props, including required config/children and optional height/layout className. */
export type DashboardChartProps = ComponentProps<typeof ChartContainer>;
/** ChartTooltipContent props; Recharts supplies payload/active and callers own value/label formatters. */
export type DashboardTooltipProps = ComponentProps<typeof ChartTooltipContent>;
/** Legend content props with the same named series config used by the marks. */
export type DashboardLegendProps = ComponentProps<typeof ChartLegendContent> & {
  /** Series labels, token colors and line patterns, keyed by dataKey. */
  config: Record<string, SeriesStyle>;
};

/** Bounded responsive chart container with keyboard focus treatment; provide an accessible data alternative. */
export function DashboardChart({ className, ...props }: DashboardChartProps) {
  return (
    <ChartContainer
      className={cn(
        "[&_.recharts-surface:focus-visible]:outline-ring aspect-auto h-64 w-full min-w-0 tabular-nums sm:h-80 [&_.recharts-surface:focus-visible]:outline-2 [&_.recharts-surface:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 [&_.recharts-surface:focus-visible]:outline-solid",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

/** Token-colored tooltip content for a Recharts Tooltip. */
export function DashboardTooltip(props: DashboardTooltipProps) {
  return (
    <ChartTooltipContent
      {...props}
      className={cn("border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground tabular-nums", props.className)}
    />
  );
}

/** Wrapping legend with bar or distinct line samples matched to the marks. */
export function DashboardLegend({ config, payload, className }: DashboardLegendProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("text-muted-foreground flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 py-3 text-xs", className)}>
      {payload
        ?.filter((entry) => entry.type !== "none")
        .map((entry) => {
          const key = String(entry.dataKey ?? entry.value);
          const series = config[key];
          if (!series) return null;
          return (
            <span key={key} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <svg width="24" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 12" aria-hidden="true" className="shrink-0">
                {entry.type === "rect" ? (
                  <rect x="6" y="0" width="12" height="12" fill={series.color} />
                ) : (
                  <line
                    x1="0"
                    y1="6"
                    x2="24"
                    y2="6"
                    stroke={series.color}
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeDasharray={series.strokeDasharray}
                  />
                )}
              </svg>
              {series.label}
            </span>
          );
        })}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Recharts primitives share this public boundary; callers retain data and composition. */
export {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  type BarShapeProps,
  CartesianGrid,
  ComposedChart,
  Label,
  LabelList,
  type LabelProps,
  Legend,
  Line,
  LineChart,
  Pie,
  PieChart,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";
```

## Source: src/components/blocks/data-table.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import type { ReactTable, RowData } from "@tanstack/react-table";

import { cn } from "cn";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowUpDown } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import type { DataTableFeatures } from "@/lib/data-table-features";

/** Presentation contract for a caller-owned TanStack Table v9 instance. */
export interface DataTableProps<T extends RowData> {
  /** Create with dataTableFeatures. The caller owns data, columns, sorting and pagination state. */
  table: ReactTable<DataTableFeatures, T>;
  /** Accessible table name and pagination landmark prefix. */
  label: string;
  /** Empty content, including any route-owned recovery action. Defaults to “No results.” */
  empty?: ReactNode;
  /** Show Previous/Next controls and row counts. Disable for caller-owned pagination. Defaults to true. */
  pagination?: boolean;
  /** Reflow into labelled fields below md, or retain a locally scrolling table. Defaults to reflow. */
  mobile?: "reflow" | "scroll";
  /** Plain labels keyed by column ID for mobile fields and sorting. Falls back to string header, then ID. */
  columnLabels?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Additional layout classes on the outer container. */
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Shared sortable table with pagination, an empty state and labelled mobile fields.
 * Derived from the existing TaskRows renderer, Products pagination and Infrastructure reflow.
 * Use non-interactive column headers: this block supplies sort buttons for sortable leaf columns.
 * Configure server sorting/pagination on the supplied instance; no fetching or route behavior lives here.
 */
export function DataTable<T extends RowData>({
  table,
  label,
  empty = "No results.",
  pagination = true,
  mobile = "reflow",
  columnLabels,
  className,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
  const reflow = mobile === "reflow";
  const rows = table.getRowModel().rows;
  const { pageIndex, pageSize } = table.state.pagination;
  const total = table.getRowCount();
  const columnLabel = (id: string) => {
    const header = table.getColumn(id)?.columnDef.header;
    return columnLabels?.[id] ?? (typeof header === "string" ? header : id);
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("min-w-0 space-y-3", className)}>
      <div className="bg-card overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
        <Table aria-label={label} role="table" className={cn(reflow && "block md:table")}>
          <TableHeader role="rowgroup" className={cn(reflow && "block md:table-header-group")}>
            {table.getHeaderGroups().map((group) => (
              <TableRow
                key={group.id}
                role="row"
                className={cn("hover:bg-transparent", reflow && "flex flex-wrap md:table-row")}
              >
                {group.headers.map((header) => {
                  const sorted = header.column.getIsSorted();
                  const sortable = !header.isPlaceholder && !header.subHeaders.length && header.column.getCanSort();
                  const sortPresentation = {
                    asc: { Icon: ArrowUp, ariaSort: "ascending" as const },
                    desc: { Icon: ArrowDown, ariaSort: "descending" as const },
                    none: { Icon: ArrowUpDown, ariaSort: "none" as const },
                  }[sorted || "none"];
                  const { Icon } = sortPresentation;
                  return (
                    <TableHead
                      key={header.id}
                      role="columnheader"
                      scope={header.colSpan > 1 ? "colgroup" : "col"}
                      colSpan={header.colSpan}
                      aria-sort={sortable ? sortPresentation.ariaSort : undefined}
                      className={cn(
                        "text-muted-foreground px-4 font-medium",
                        reflow && "flex items-center md:table-cell",
                      )}
                    >
                      {!header.isPlaceholder &&
                        (sortable ? (
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="-mx-2"
                            aria-label={`Sort by ${columnLabel(header.column.id)}`}
                            onClick={() => header.column.toggleSorting()}
                          >
                            <table.FlexRender header={header} />
                            <Icon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          </Button>
                        ) : (
                          <table.FlexRender header={header} />
                        ))}
                    </TableHead>
                  );
                })}
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody role="rowgroup" className={cn(reflow && "block md:table-row-group")}>
            {rows.length ? (
              rows.map((row) => (
                <TableRow
                  key={row.id}
                  role="row"
                  data-state={table.state.rowSelection[row.id] ? "selected" : undefined}
                  className={cn("border-border", reflow && "grid grid-cols-2 gap-y-1 py-3 md:table-row md:py-0")}
                >
                  {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                    <TableCell
                      key={cell.id}
                      role="cell"
                      className={cn(
                        "px-4 py-2 align-middle",
                        reflow && "block min-w-0 wrap-anywhere whitespace-normal md:table-cell",
                      )}
                    >
                      {reflow && (
                        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-muted-foreground mb-1 block text-xs md:hidden">
                          {columnLabel(cell.column.id)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <table.FlexRender cell={cell} />
                    </TableCell>
                  ))}
                </TableRow>
              ))
            ) : (
              <TableRow role="row" className={cn(reflow && "block md:table-row")}>
                <TableCell
                  role="cell"
                  colSpan={Math.max(1, table.getVisibleLeafColumns().length)}
                  className={cn(
                    "text-muted-foreground h-24 p-4 text-center whitespace-normal",
                    reflow && "block content-center md:table-cell",
                  )}
                >
                  {empty}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            )}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>
      {pagination && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm tabular-nums" role="status">
            {rows.length ? pageIndex * pageSize + 1 : 0}–{rows.length ? pageIndex * pageSize + rows.length : 0} of{" "}
            {total} rows
          </p>
          <nav aria-label={`${label} pages`} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
              onClick={() => table.previousPage()}
            >
              Previous
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()} onClick={() => table.nextPage()}>
              Next
            </Button>
          </nav>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { cn } from "cn";

/** Props for the shared app-page heading. */
export interface PageHeaderProps {
  /** Page name, rendered as h1. Use once per page. */
  title: string;
  /** Optional supporting sentence below the title. */
  description?: string;
  /** Route-owned controls in a wrapping action row. */
  actions?: ReactNode;
  /** Additional layout classes on the outer row. */
  className?: string;
}

/** Responsive app-page h1, description and actions; owns no data or navigation. */
export function PageHeader({ title, description, actions, className }: PageHeaderProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4", className)}>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-64">
        <h1 className="text-2xl leading-tight font-medium tracking-tight wrap-break-word">{title}</h1>
        {description && <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-sm wrap-break-word">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      {actions && <div className="flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{actions}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Button as ButtonPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/button"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "cn"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "group/button inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-clip-padding text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "control-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground",
        outline:
          "control-recipe",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[color-mix(in_oklch,var(--secondary),var(--foreground)_5%)] aria-expanded:bg-secondary aria-expanded:text-secondary-foreground",
        ghost:
          "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-raised hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20 focus-visible:border-destructive/40 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:hover:bg-destructive/30 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default:
          "h-8 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] px-2 text-xs in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        sm: "h-7 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] px-2.5 text-[0.8rem] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5",
        lg: "h-9 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        icon: "size-8",
        "icon-xs":
          "size-6 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        "icon-sm":
          "size-7 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg",
        "icon-lg": "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: ButtonPrimitive.Props & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants>) {
  return (
    <ButtonPrimitive
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Button, buttonVariants }
```

## Source: src/components/ui/chart.tsx

```tsx
import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts"
import type { TooltipValueType } from "recharts"

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const

const INITIAL_DIMENSION = { width: 320, height: 200 } as const
type TooltipNameType = number | string

export type ChartConfig = Record<
  string,
  {
    label?: React.ReactNode
    icon?: React.ComponentType
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  )
>

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig
}

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null)

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />")
  }

  return context
}

function ChartContainer({
  id,
  className,
  children,
  config,
  initialDimension = INITIAL_DIMENSION,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  config: ChartConfig
  children: React.ComponentProps<
    typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
  >["children"]
  initialDimension?: {
    width: number
    height: number
  }
}) {
  const uniqueId = React.useId()
  const chartId = `chart-${id ?? uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-slot="chart"
        data-chart={chartId}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-hidden [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-hidden [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-hidden",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
          initialDimension={initialDimension}
        >
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  )
}

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([, config]) => config.theme ?? config.color
  )

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ??
      itemConfig.color
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  )
}

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip

function ChartTooltipContent({
  active,
  payload,
  className,
  indicator = "dot",
  hideLabel = false,
  hideIndicator = false,
  label,
  labelFormatter,
  labelClassName,
  formatter,
  color,
  nameKey,
  labelKey,
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    hideLabel?: boolean
    hideIndicator?: boolean
    indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed"
    nameKey?: string
    labelKey?: string
  } & Omit<
    RechartsPrimitive.DefaultTooltipContentProps<
      TooltipValueType,
      TooltipNameType
    >,
    "accessibilityLayer"
  >) {
  const { config } = useChart()

  const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    const [item] = payload
    const key = `${labelKey ?? item?.dataKey ?? item?.name ?? "value"}`
    const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
    const value =
      !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
        ? (config[label]?.label ?? label)
        : itemConfig?.label

    if (labelFormatter) {
      return (
        <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
          {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
        </div>
      )
    }

    if (!value) {
      return null
    }

    return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>
  }, [
    label,
    labelFormatter,
    payload,
    hideLabel,
    labelClassName,
    config,
    labelKey,
  ])

  if (!active || !payload?.length) {
    return null
  }

  const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot"

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "grid min-w-32 items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
        className
      )}
    >
      {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        {payload
          .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
          .map((item, index) => {
            const key = `${nameKey ?? item.name ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
            const indicatorColor = color ?? item.payload?.fill ?? item.color

            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={cn(
                  "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                  indicator === "dot" && "items-center"
                )}
              >
                {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                  formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                      <itemConfig.icon />
                    ) : (
                      !hideIndicator && (
                        <div
                          className={cn(
                            "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-bg)",
                            {
                              "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                              "w-1": indicator === "line",
                              "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                                indicator === "dashed",
                              "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                            }
                          )}
                          style={
                            {
                              "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                              "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                            } as React.CSSProperties
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                        nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {itemConfig?.label ?? item.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {item.value != null && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium text-foreground tabular-nums">
                          {typeof item.value === "number"
                            ? item.value.toLocaleString()
                            : String(item.value)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend

function ChartLegendContent({
  className,
  hideIcon = false,
  payload,
  verticalAlign = "bottom",
  nameKey,
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  hideIcon?: boolean
  nameKey?: string
} & RechartsPrimitive.DefaultLegendContentProps) {
  const { config } = useChart()

  if (!payload?.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
        verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
        className
      )}
    >
      {payload
        .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
        .map((item, index) => {
          const key = `${nameKey ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`
          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)

          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                <itemConfig.icon />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: item.color,
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {itemConfig?.label}
            </div>
          )
        })}
    </div>
  )
}

function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined

  let configLabelKey: string = key

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string
  }

  return configLabelKey in config ? config[configLabelKey] : config[key]
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
}

```

```tsx
import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"

function Table({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"table">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="table-container"
      className="relative w-full overflow-x-auto"
    >
      <table
        data-slot="table"
        className={cn("w-full caption-bottom text-sm", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

function TableHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"thead">) {
  return (
    <thead
      data-slot="table-header"
      className={cn("[&_tr]:border-b", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function TableBody({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"tbody">) {
  return (
    <tbody
      data-slot="table-body"
      className={cn("[&_tr:last-child]:border-0", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function TableFooter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"tfoot">) {
  return (
    <tfoot
      data-slot="table-footer"
      className={cn(
        "border-t bg-muted/50 font-medium [&>tr]:last:border-b-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function TableRow({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"tr">) {
  return (
    <tr
      data-slot="table-row"
      className={cn(
        "border-b transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 has-aria-expanded:bg-muted/50 data-[state=selected]:bg-muted",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function TableHead({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"th">) {
  return (
    <th
      data-slot="table-head"
      className={cn(
        "h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-foreground [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function TableCell({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"td">) {
  return (
    <td
      data-slot="table-cell"
      className={cn(
        "p-2 align-middle whitespace-nowrap [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function TableCaption({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"caption">) {
  return (
    <caption
      data-slot="table-caption"
      className={cn("mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Table,
  TableHeader,
  TableBody,
  TableFooter,
  TableHead,
  TableRow,
  TableCell,
  TableCaption,
}
```

## Source: src/lib/data-table-features.ts

```tsx
import {
  columnFacetingFeature,
  columnFilteringFeature,
  columnSizingFeature,
  columnVisibilityFeature,
  createFacetedRowModel,
  createFacetedUniqueValues,
  createFilteredRowModel,
  createPaginatedRowModel,
  createSortedRowModel,
  filterFn_arrIncludes,
  filterFn_equalsString,
  filterFn_includesString,
  globalFilteringFeature,
  rowPaginationFeature,
  rowSelectionFeature,
  rowSortingFeature,
  sortFn_alphanumeric,
  sortFn_datetime,
  sortFn_text,
  tableFeatures,
} from "@tanstack/react-table";

/**
 * Central TanStack Table v9 feature registry for every dashboard data table.
 * V9 requires features and built-in functions to be registered explicitly; sharing this registry and its inferred type
 * keeps useTable instances, ColumnDef declarations, and reusable table helpers on the same feature contract. Explicit
 * registration also lets the bundler tree-shake features, row models, and filter/sort functions unused by the dashboard.
 */
export const dataTableFeatures = tableFeatures({
  columnFacetingFeature,
  columnFilteringFeature,
  columnSizingFeature,
  columnVisibilityFeature,
  globalFilteringFeature,
  rowPaginationFeature,
  rowSelectionFeature,
  rowSortingFeature,
  facetedRowModel: createFacetedRowModel(),
  facetedUniqueValues: createFacetedUniqueValues(),
  filteredRowModel: createFilteredRowModel(),
  paginatedRowModel: createPaginatedRowModel(),
  sortedRowModel: createSortedRowModel(),
  filterFns: {
    arrIncludes: filterFn_arrIncludes,
    equalsString: filterFn_equalsString,
    includesString: filterFn_includesString,
  },
  sortFns: {
    alphanumeric: sortFn_alphanumeric,
    datetime: sortFn_datetime,
    text: sortFn_text,
  },
});

export type DataTableFeatures = typeof dataTableFeatures;

```
